description.en: Control Rain Bird irrigation controllers with an LNK Wi-Fi module over your local network. Start and stop each watering zone, set a rain delay, and monitor the rain sensor and the currently running zone. No Rain Bird cloud account is required - control is entirely local.

value.en: On the next screen, enter the IP address and device password of your Rain Bird LNK Wi-Fi module. The password is the one you set in the Rain Bird app. The controller must be powered on and connected to your network.
